propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 corrupts code spans by escaping punctuation, deletes HTML comments, and rewrites comment delimiters when arrows are substituted naively
A two-phase lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, HTML comments, backtick fences, and four-space-indented blocks before processing intervening text
Code fragments must be extracted and preserved exactly in post-render output; if any source code fragment is missing or altered in the rendered output, the unit falls back to original Markdown

An inline-Jira classifier must distinguish UNAMBIGUOUS wiki markers ({{monospace}}, [label|target], {color:name}) that settle a unit alone from AMBIGUOUS markers (*strong*, _emphasis_) that only settle units without CommonMark-only constructs, preventing 2-cycle re-renders

A segmenting renderer with deterministic 178-body corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) must achieve >=0.90 body ratio and >=0.95 character ratio of content rendered rich without losing code fragments or corrupting tables
Arrow substitution (<!-- → itself, --> → itself, <-> → ↔, -> → →, <- → ←, => → ⇒) must occur in a single regex pass after code masking and before any prose rendering
